title: Sr. Software Development Engineer
description:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.
  
  
We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

As a passionate engineer you will work with a team of cloud architects in building scalable, high performance backend applications for our cloud engineering org. You will play a pivotal role in enhancing our multitenant architecture and global footprint for the world’s largest cloud security platform.

* Implementing scalable, high-performance backend services and APIs
* Ensuring code quality by writing and maintaining unit, integration, and performance tests; monitor, debug, and optimize system performance
* Collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver integrated solutions and contribute to Agile/Scrum processes like sprint planning and retrospectives
* Participating in on-call rotation to support a highly available engineering platform

* You thrive in ambiguity. You're comfortable building the path as you walk it. You thrive in a dynamic environment, seeing ambiguity not as a hindrance, but as the raw material to build something meaningful.

* You are a high-trust collaborator. You are ambitious for the team, not just yourself. You embrace our challenge culture by giving and receiving ongoing feedback—knowing that candor delivered with clarity and respect is the truest form of teamwork and the fastest way to earn trust.
* You are a learner. You have a true growth mindset and are obsessed with your own development, actively seeking feedback to become a better partner and a stronger teammate. You love what you do and you do it with purpose.

**What We’re Looking For (Minimum Qualifications)**

* Foundational understanding of AI/ML technologies and experience leveraging, securing, or positioning AI-driven solutions to optimize outcomes within your functional domain
* 3+ years of experience with proficiency coding in Java / Golang or similar
* Hands-on experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and one or more major cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure)
* Expertise in designing and maintaining large-scale distributed systems with strong fundamentals of scaling, availability and design trade offs
* Exceptional problem-solving skills for creating robust solutions and resolving complex issues with root cause analysis

**What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)**

* Experience leveraging LLMs or AI code-assistance platforms to accelerate distributed systems development, code refactoring, and automated testing pipelines

* Excellent communication and cross-team collaboration skills, with the ability to navigate ambiguity, make high-impact technical decisions, and deliver results with minimal oversight

At Zscaler, we are committed to building a team that reflects the communities we serve and the customers we work with. We foster an inclusive environment that values all backgrounds and perspectives, emphasizing collaboration and belonging. Join us in our mission to make doing business seamless and secure.

title: Software Engineer (.NET and Angular)
description:
Every day, millions of shipments move around the world on data that nobody is looking at in real time. Orders, ASNs, invoices, and tracking events flow between 3PLs, forwarders, brands, and retailers, then get flattened into a status that tells you something went wrong only after it already has.

SwiftB2B exists to change that. We are an AI operating system for global supply chains. One platform where 3PLs, freight forwarders, brands, retailers, and manufacturers can see every item, shipment, and exception as it happens. The platform does not stop at flagging a delay. It works out what the delay costs, weighs the options, and starts the fix.

We built it on 15 years of SwiftAnt’s work in supply chain and EDI technology, and on a team that has spent careers in logistics, retail, and enterprise software.

A coding agent now writes most of the code, but what it cannot do is know which of three plausible designs is the one a customer can still change in three years, or notice that the requirement was wrong before the code was. Code that compiles is not always code that is correct. We want engineers who own a whole feature, who treat reviewing AI-written code as the real work rather than a formality, and who are building the next generation of agents that do real work inside the product behind a human gate.

**What you will do**

* Own features end to end: the Angular screen, the .NET service behind it, the data model underneath, the API contract at its edge, the tests that hold it together, and the runbook for whoever inherits it.
* Work with Claude Code and similar tools every day. Generate fast, review hard, and keep a written review standard so what one engineer checks by instinct the next one does not miss.
* Publish and agree API contracts before anything is built behind them. Retrofitting a contract costs more than it saved.
* Design and prove event contracts on Kafka: delivery guarantees demonstrated by replay, not asserted in a design note.
* Build identity and access on Keycloak and OpenID Connect, reviewed before build.
* Take one database as your primary (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, or MongoDB) and carry the other two at working depth so you know when you have chosen wrong.
* Ship through a secure CI/CD pipeline with automated tests, with accessibility and performance demonstrated by test rather than claimed in a status report.
* Build agents that do real work in the product (exception triage, document handling, customer-facing drafts) with a written boundary and a tested human gate before they touch anything a customer sees.
* Hand features over cleanly - the test of finished is that another engineer is able to change your feature without asking you a question.

**What we are looking for**

* Real production experience across the stack: C# and .NET on the back end, Angular and TypeScript on the front end. Angular 17 or later preferred.
* Strong relational data modelling on at least one of SQL Server or PostgreSQL. MongoDB experience is a plus.
* You have designed REST APIs that other teams consumed, and you know what idempotency, versioning, and backward compatibility cost when ignored.
* Experience with event-driven systems. Kafka preferred, any service bus fine.
* Hands-on with OAuth2 and OIDC. Keycloak is a plus.
* You already use AI coding tools seriously and you have war stories about working, wrong code they produced. Experience building agents with an SDK (Claude Agent SDK, Semantic Kernel, LangGraph) is a strong plus.
* Automated testing as a habit, not a phase. Playwright or similar for the front end, a secure pipeline on Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions.
* Azure experience. AZ-204 is nice to have.
* A background in supply chain, logistics, or B2B enterprise software is an advantage.
* A degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

**Not sure you tick every box?**

Apply anyway. Nobody we have hired matched the list line for line. If you have shipped features that other people maintained without you, and you have strong views on how to review AI-generated code, we want to talk to you. Link us something you built and tell us the design decision you would make differently now. That tells us more than a polished CV.

**Equal opportunity**

SwiftB2B hires on skill, talent, and curiosity. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, nationality, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability, or any other protected characteristic. If you need an adjustment at any stage of the process, tell us and we will make it happen.

****Job Description****
Job Description
  
  
****Job Description****

You will design and operate services, APIs, and data pipelines in a CI/CD-driven environment.

* Design, implement, and maintain secure, scalable and fault-tolerant data ingestion pipelines from a wide variety of source systems, including SAP, Salesforce, SharePoint, APIs, and (legacy) manufacturing platforms.
* Build and enhance production-grade metadata-driven data handling components and inbound-/outbound-interfaces.
* Own production data interfaces end-to-end.
* Develop reusable, version-controlled platform components, APIs, or data interfaces, following software engineering best practices (CI/CD, automated testing, version control, monitoring).

* Establish and maintain holistic data quality management, monitoring and reporting.
* Collaborates across business IT, cybersecurity, infrastructure, and architecture teams to ensure secure and sustainable delivery.

**Main Tasks:**

* Design and implement fault-tolerant, observable data pipelines, including logging, alerting, and failure handling strategies.
* Build and maintain Python- or Scala-based extraction services (e.g., Debezium Server, custom APIs, rclone)
* Implement CDC, delta, and event-based patterns.
* Build and enhance push-based HTTP, Kerberos-authenticated custom data lake transfer delivery component.
* Integrate with systems such as Salesforce, SharePoint, and other API- or file-based endpoints.
* Establish, operate and troubleshoot extraction from SAP using tools like Theobald Extract Universal.
* Establish and maintain a web-accessible data catalog application as part of the data platform, focusing on backend services, metadata management, and integration with platform components.
* Integrate dataset discoverability, preview/exploration options, and lineage information using Unity Catalog as a backend metadata system.
* Design and implement structured access request workflows including request submission, approval chains, audit trail, and enablement triggers.
* Perform design reviews with Cybersecurity.
* Ensure documentation and compliance for all interfaces and data ingress points.
* Manage audit and traceability requirements.
* Collaborate closely with IT and business users to translate requirements into scalable technical patterns.
* Serve as technical escalation point for complex source integration.
* Define and implement a multi-layered data quality framework, including unit-level, integration-level, and cross-pipeline validation rules.
* Establish centralized and version-controlled storage of DQ rules, with integration into orchestration and CI/CD pipelines.
* Implement automatic DQ monitoring with severity levels (Critical, High, Medium, Low) and enable flagging, filtering, and quarantining logic at relevant stages of the pipeline.
* Collaborate with source system owners and business stakeholders to define meaningful and actionable DQ thresholds.

****Qualifications****
Qualifications
  
  
Degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, or a related field.
  
  

* 5–8 years in software development, with hands-on experience with inbound- and outbound data exchange interfaces, using a variety of technologies, such as APIs, CDC, managing endpoints.
* Hands-on experience with Scala / Java, Python, and advanced SQL, using Git for collaborative development and CI/CD methodologies.
* Experience building robust ingestion pipelines and ETL-jobs in a software engineering context.
* Track record with Azure or other hyperscaler resource management.
* Familiarity with data lake housing and data warehousing, Databricks and Azure knowledge is a plus.
* Comfortable working across geographies and time zones; collaborates effectively with global teams and enterprise stakeholders.
* Candidates with a strong backend/software engineering background (e.g. Java, Scala, distributed systems) who want to move into data platform engineering are highly encouraged to apply.

****NOT a Fit If Your Experience Is Primarily:****
▪ Notebook-based data processing (e.g. Jupyter, ad-hoc PySpark) without production deployment
  
  
▪ Dashboarding / analytics / BI tools
  
  
▪ SQL-only roles without software engineering experience
  
  
****Additional Information****
Additional information
  
  
The Well-being Of Our Employees Is Important To Us. That's Why We Offer Exciting Career Prospects And Support You In Achieving a Good Work-life Balance With Additional Benefits Such As:

title: Python Developer
description:
Every day, millions of shipments move around the world on data that nobody is looking at in real time. Orders, ASNs, invoices, and tracking events flow between 3PLs, forwarders, brands, and retailers, then get flattened into a status that tells you something went wrong only after it already has.

SwiftB2B exists to change that. We are an AI operating system for global supply chains. One platform where 3PLs, freight forwarders, brands, retailers, and manufacturers can see every item, shipment, and exception as it happens. The platform does not stop at flagging a delay. It works out what the delay costs, weighs the options, and starts the fix.

We built it on 15 years of SwiftAnt’s work in supply chain and EDI technology, and on a team that has spent careers in logistics, retail, and enterprise software. We are a Databricks partner and our data platform runs on the lakehouse.

A lot of the intelligence in this product is Python - the services that parse an inbound EDI file and turn it into a shipment, the jobs that score an exception and work out what it costs, the agents that draft a response to a carrier and wait for a human to approve it, the evaluation harness that tells us whether the natural-language query answered correctly. We need someone who writes Python for production, with tests and types and logging, and who is comfortable working next to data engineers on Databricks and AI engineers building agents. Supply chain knowledge is a bonus.

**What you will do**

* Build and maintain backend services in Python (FastAPI or similar) that sit between our data platform and the product: shipment and order APIs, exception scoring, notification and workflow services.
* Write the parsers and transformers for logistics data formats: X12 and EDIFACT EDI, carrier and TMS APIs, flat files from warehouses, and the occasional spreadsheet a customer insists on.
* Build the plumbing for our AI features: tool definitions for agents, structured outputs, retrieval over governed metrics, evaluation harnesses, cost and latency logging per call. You will work with the Claude Agent SDK and Databricks Mosaic AI.
* Write Databricks jobs and notebooks in PySpark when the work belongs on the lakehouse, and plain Python services when it does not. Knowing which is which is part of the job.
* Ship through CI/CD with tests at every layer: unit, contract, integration. Add observability so a failure in production tells you what broke.
* Review AI-generated code properly. We use Claude Code daily. The code it writes compiles and usually runs. Whether it is correct is your call, and the review is recorded.
* Write the runbook for what you build so that someone else can operate it when you are not around.

**What we are looking for**

* Three or more years writing Python that ran in production and that other people depended on.
* Solid with the modern Python toolchain: type hints, pydantic, pytest, async, packaging, linting. FastAPI or Flask experience in production.
* Strong SQL. Experience with PostgreSQL or SQL Server. PySpark and Databricks experience is a strong plus.
* You have integrated with messy external systems: REST APIs with bad documentation, SFTP drops, file formats with no schema. EDI experience is a plus.
* Experience with message queues or event streaming (Kafka, Service Bus, Event Hubs).
* You have built or worked on LLM-backed features: tool use, structured output, evaluation. Experience with an agent SDK is a plus.
* Azure experience, Docker, and CI/CD with GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps.
* A background in supply chain, logistics, or B2B software is an advantage.
* A degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

**Not sure you tick every box?**

Apply anyway. Nobody we have hired matched the list line for line. If you have shipped Python services that other teams relied on, and you have an opinion about how to review code an AI wrote, we want to talk to you. Link us a repo, or describe the ugliest file format you ever had to parse and how you did it. That tells us more than a polished CV.

**Equal opportunity**

SwiftB2B hires on skill, talent, and curiosity. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, nationality, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability, or any other protected characteristic. If you need an adjustment at any stage of the process, tell us and we will make it happen.

title: Databricks Engineer
description:
Every day, millions of shipments move around the world on data that nobody is looking at in real time. Orders, ASNs, invoices, and tracking events flow between 3PLs, forwarders, brands, and retailers, then get flattened into a status that tells you something went wrong only after it already has.

SwiftB2B exists to change that. We are an AI operating system for global supply chains. One platform where 3PLs, freight forwarders, brands, retailers, and manufacturers can see every item, shipment, and exception as it happens. The platform does not stop at flagging a delay. It works out what the delay costs, weighs the options, and starts the fix.

We built it on 15 years of SwiftAnt’s work in supply chain and EDI technology, and on a team that has spent careers in logistics, retail, and enterprise software. We are a Databricks partner and the platform runs on the lakehouse.

This role is for someone who has gone all the way across Databricks and built something real on it. Not just pipelines, but apps on Databricks Apps, agents on the Mosaic AI Agent Framework, a model behind Model Serving, Vector Search, Genie spaces, Lakebase, AI/BI dashboards, Asset Bundles to ship it all. Most Databricks people know one corner of the platform well. We want a candidate who knows how the corners fit together and has proof. We would love to see what you built and understand your decisions, and hear what you would do differently.

**What you will do**

* Build customer-facing and internal applications on Databricks Apps, backed by Lakebase and Unity Catalog, that put the lakehouse directly in front of supply chain users.
* Build and deploy agents with the Mosaic AI Agent Framework: tools over governed metrics, MLflow tracing, evaluation with Agent Evaluation, deployment through Model Serving. Exception triage, carrier communication, customer Q&A, all behind a human gate.
* Stand up Genie spaces over our semantic layer so customers can ask questions in plain language and get governed answers, and build the evaluation sets that prove the answers are right.
* Use Vector Search and Foundation Model APIs for retrieval over documents nobody wants to read by hand: carrier contracts, rate cards, customs paperwork, partner EDI specs.
* Work with our data engineers on Lakeflow, Delta Live Tables, and Unity Catalog so the data feeding the apps and agents is governed, fresh, and lineage-tracked.
* Package and ship everything with Databricks Asset Bundles through CI/CD, with environments, secrets, and permissions handled properly.
* Be our in-house expert on what is new on the platform. When Databricks ships a feature, you are the person who has tried it by Friday and can say whether it belongs in the product.
* Represent us to Databricks and to customers: solution reviews, partner showcases, the occasional conference talk if you want one.

**What we are looking for**

* You have built a complete thing on Databricks that real users touched. An app, an agent, a Genie-powered assistant, a model in production. We want to see it, or as much of it as you are allowed to show.
* Hands-on across the platform: Databricks Apps, Mosaic AI (Agent Framework, Model Serving, Vector Search, Foundation Model APIs), Genie, Unity Catalog, Lakeflow or DLT, MLflow, Asset Bundles. Lakebase and Delta Sharing are a plus.
* Strong Python. Comfortable with a web framework (FastAPI, Streamlit, Dash, or similar) for Apps, and with PySpark for the data side.
* You understand governance as a design input: permissions, row and column security, lineage, and why an agent must only answer from governed data.
* Databricks certifications are a plus, especially Generative AI Engineer Associate and Data Engineer Associate. The thing you built matters more.
* Azure experience preferred, since that is where we run.
* A background in supply chain, logistics, or operations data is an advantage.
* A degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

**Not sure you tick every box?**

Apply anyway. Nobody we have hired matched the list line for line. If you have built something on Databricks that you are proud of, that is the whole application. Send us a link, a video, a repo, or a write-up, and two or three sentences on the hardest decision in it.

**Equal opportunity**

SwiftB2B hires on skill, talent, and curiosity. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, nationality, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability, or any other protected characteristic. If you need an adjustment at any stage of the process, tell us and we will make it happen.
